correctness.rationale: The primitive active toric facet normals are an oriented reduced graph-incidence map with a connected active graph. Its cokernel equals integral graph cohomology, so it has no torsion and rank equal to the cycle count. Filter frontiers give the leaf formula, disjoint child filters give the generating recurrence, terminal unary tails give the smooth fixed-point count, and binary-tree counting gives the stated bound. The independent exact checker validates integral spanning-tree minors and all combinatorial identities for 17,471 filters of 1,442 rooted labeled trees and height-0-through-3 binary trees; the symbolic argument proves all parameters.

value.rationale: This computes a natural intrinsic birational invariant at every torus-fixed point in all rooted-tree Hibi varieties, including torsion, and packages its complete rank distribution as a recursive polynomial. The exact terminal-leaf-tail smooth count and exponentially vanishing smooth fraction for complete binary trees distinguish geometries that global class groups or total vertex counts do not. It is an infinite natural family classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
